instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on his left leg, kicking his right foot forward. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing him, watching the kick. The man's foot lightly touches the woman's thigh. The scene is brightly lit by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
